purpose: Evidence for an independent React reference approximation, not an official component or studio screen spec.

scope.completeness: Selected pilot only; not all Button variants or all Nightingale components.

local.root: User-supplied local Nightingale package root; not bundled in this repository.

codeConnect.status: Template confirms component/prop correspondence for rest and loading; React web API equivalence is not established.

existingAdapter.status: Temporary approximation; current props only add primary/secondary variant to native button attributes.

tokenEvidence.note: The web size map also supplies 54 directly for md; this is not exclusively token-driven.

Hover context emits a 2px solid border. Rest, pressed, and disabled generated context omit an explicit border, while local web styles always set one. Figma stroke and box geometry need direct reconciliation; omission alone does not prove a zero-width design stroke.
Declared values agree; rendered width still depends on border sizing and font metrics.
Generated Figma context declares 16px; local web styles set height and centering but do not set vertical padding. Do not copy 16px into a fixed-height border box without measuring.
Figma variable/style definitions and local light-theme value agree after hex-case normalization.
Effective hover override differs from merely reading the base state map.
The body-02 base weight token is 600, but Button applies the bold override. Font files have not been loaded or redistributed.
Colour and base blur/spread are evidenced. Local code adds a 2px white gap and increases spread; rendered focus geometry and the Figma effect asset have not been compared.

openQuestions.question: Should the reference prioritize measured Figma geometry or the local web box model where generated padding/border declarations differ?
openQuestions.assumption: Neither source silently overrides the other; measure and approve a resolution before implementation.

openQuestions.question: Should loading preserve the resting width or use the Figma loading node's 150px width, and which palette/motion details are authoritative?
openQuestions.assumption: Loading context is incomplete. Returned loading variables include primary-a3 and primary-b1, which alone do not prove a background colour conflict. Inspect spinner and full node context first.

openQuestions.question: Is the documented Sharp Sans font available and authorized for the reference preview?
openQuestions.assumption: No font is copied. A fallback would be explicitly labelled and prevents a claim of exact typography fidelity.

openQuestions.question: Approve the pilot scope and geometry/capture tolerances after resolving the evidence gaps.
openQuestions.assumption: Exact resolved colours and typography values are proposed; no geometry or screenshot threshold is approved yet.

verification.mcpReads: metadata, five state design contexts/screenshots, variable definitions, and labelled Code Connect mappings returned successfully

acceptanceCriteria: Approve exact variant/state scope and reconcile recorded conflicts before implementation.
Keep all implemented visual properties tied to approved token mappings or explicitly documented literals.
Measure height, padding, border, radius, typography, and focus geometry against approved values and numeric tolerances.
Capture all scoped states with matched browser, viewport, pixel ratio, theme, font, and text.
Test Tab focus and Enter/Space activation; verify disabled/loading suppress activation and have appropriate accessible names and announcements.
Report each excluded or untested state explicitly; do not describe source extraction as a visual pass.
